request.description: Changes the name, description or status. An inactive set is never served, whatever its versions. Content changes go through versions. Staff only. Question sets are versioned config: draft → submit (maker) → approve or reject (a different staff member, in Change Requests) → publish → retire. Reading needs config read access; making, publishing and retiring need config maker access for question sets (ops lead, super admin).
